key: TRAINER: My Kricketot hasn't been doing well at all lately...
en: TRAINER: My Kricketot hasn't been doing well at all lately...
ja: トレーナー: うちのコロボーシ、最近ずっと調子が悪くて……

key: It's so lethargic.
en: It's so lethargic.
ja: ぐったりしてるんです。

key: I don't know what to do, so I called in someone to help.
en: I don't know what to do, so I called in someone to help.
ja: どうしていいか分からなくて、誰かに助けを頼んだんです。

key: ???: Um... Hello?
en: ???: Um... Hello?
ja: ???: あの……こんにちは?

key: ???: Oh, oh!
en: ???: Oh, oh!

key: TRAINER: Are you Shelly?
en: TRAINER: Are you Shelly?
ja: トレーナー: シェリーさんですか?

key: SHELLY: That's me. It's nice to meet you!
en: SHELLY: That's me. It's nice to meet you!
ja: シェリー: そうです。よろしくお願いします!

key: Um... Is this the Pokémon you told me about?
en: Um... Is this the Pokémon you told me about?
ja: あの……これが、お話しされていたポケモンですか?

key: TRAINER: It's my Kricketot. It really hasn't been feeling well.
en: TRAINER: It's my Kricketot. It really hasn't been feeling well.
ja: トレーナー: うちのコロボーシです。本当に調子が悪くて。

key: SHELLY: Okay... Poor thing.
en: SHELLY: Okay... Poor thing.
ja: シェリー: そうですか……かわいそうに。

key: Um, I know Bug Pokémon pretty well, so...
en: Um, I know Bug Pokémon pretty well, so...
ja: あの、わたし、むしポケモンには結構詳しいので……

key: Let me take a look?
en: Let me take a look?
ja: 見せてもらえますか?

key: SHELLY: Oh...
en: SHELLY: Oh...
ja: シェリー: あっ……

key: Ummm, well, the good news is that your Kricketot isn't sick!
en: Ummm, well, the good news is that your Kricketot isn't sick!
ja: ええと、その、いいお知らせなんですけど、コロボーシは病気じゃないですよ!

key: But, it is really lonely.
en: But, it is really lonely.
ja: でも、すごく寂しがってるんです。

key: I know how that goes, too. Does it get out much?
en: I know how that goes, too. Does it get out much?
ja: その気持ち、わたしも分かります。外にはよく出してあげてますか?

key: TRAINER: No...
en: TRAINER: No...
ja: トレーナー: いえ……

key: I get pretty busy and can't take care of it as much as I should.
en: I get pretty busy and can't take care of it as much as I should.
ja: 忙しくて、ちゃんと世話をしてあげられていないんです。

key: SHELLY: I think that's the problem...
en: SHELLY: I think that's the problem...
ja: シェリー: それが原因だと思います……

key: Um... It would be best for Kricketot if it was with an active Trainer...
en: Um... It would be best for Kricketot if it was with an active Trainer...
ja: あの……コロボーシにとっては、活動的なトレーナーと一緒にいるのが一番だと思うんです……

key: TRAINER: I see... If it's what's best for Kricketot, then...
en: TRAINER: I see... If it's what's best for Kricketot, then...
ja: トレーナー: そうですか……コロボーシのためになるなら……

key: Excuse me, would you be willing to look after Kricketot?
en: Excuse me, would you be willing to look after Kricketot?
ja: すみません、コロボーシの面倒を見ていただけませんか?

key: I want to, but if it's going to suffer, I shouldn't keep it, and you look like a bright Trainer.
en: I want to, but if it's going to suffer, I shouldn't keep it, and you look like a bright Trainer.
ja: 手放したくはないんですが、苦しませるくらいなら手元に置くべきじゃないですし、あなたは活発なトレーナーに見えます。

key: Will you keep Kricketot for me?
en: Will you keep Kricketot for me?
ja: コロボーシを引き取っていただけますか?

key: TRAINER: Thank you. Please take good care of Kricketot for me.
en: TRAINER: Thank you. Please take good care of Kricketot for me.
ja: トレーナー: ありがとうございます。コロボーシをどうぞよろしくお願いします。

key: SHELLY: I think it'll be just fine then!
en: SHELLY: I think it'll be just fine then!
ja: シェリー: それなら、きっと大丈夫です!

key: I guess I should get back to my Gym, though. I can't be away too long, hehe.
en: I guess I should get back to my Gym, though. I can't be away too long, hehe.
ja: でも、そろそろジムに戻らないと。あまり長く離れられないので、えへへ。

key: TRAINER: Oh...
en: TRAINER: Oh...
ja: トレーナー: あ……

key: SHELLY: Would you mind if I kept it? I can keep Kricketot with the other Pokémon in my Gym.
en: SHELLY: Would you mind if I kept it? I can keep Kricketot with the other Pokémon in my Gym.
ja: シェリー: わたしが引き取ってもいいですか? コロボーシを、ジムの他のポケモンたちと一緒にいさせられますし。

key: TRAINER: Of-of course... It would be an honor for Reborn's Bug Gym Leader to adopt my Kricketot...
en: TRAINER: Of-of course... It would be an honor for Reborn's Bug Gym Leader to adopt my Kricketot...
ja: トレーナー: も、もちろんです……リボーンのむしジムリーダーにコロボーシを引き取っていただけるなんて、光栄です……

key: SHELLY: Okay. I'll make sure it has more friends than it knows what to do with!
en: SHELLY: Okay. I'll make sure it has more friends than it knows what to do with!
ja: シェリー: 分かりました。友達がありあまるくらい増やしてあげますね!

key: Well, well, Kricketot, looks like you're coming with me.
en: Well, well, Kricketot, looks like you're coming with me.
ja: さてさて、コロボーシ、これからわたしと一緒だね。

key: Um, don't worry! You'll be just fine!
en: Um, don't worry! You'll be just fine!
ja: あの、心配しないで! きっと大丈夫だから!

key: SHELLY: Um... Bye! It was nice to meet both of you!
en: SHELLY: Um... Bye! It was nice to meet both of you!
ja: シェリー: あの……それじゃ! お二人とも、お会いできて良かったです!

key: Feel free to stop by my Gym whenever you'd like!
en: Feel free to stop by my Gym whenever you'd like!
ja: よかったら、いつでもジムに寄ってくださいね!

key: TRAINER: My Dwebble hasn't been doing well at all lately...
en: TRAINER: My Dwebble hasn't been doing well at all lately...
ja: トレーナー: うちのイシズマイ、最近ずっと調子が悪くて……

key: TRAINER: It's my Dwebble. It really hasn't been feeling well.
en: TRAINER: It's my Dwebble. It really hasn't been feeling well.
ja: トレーナー: うちのイシズマイです。本当に調子が悪くて。

key: Ummm, well, the good news is that your Dwebble isn't sick!
en: Ummm, well, the good news is that your Dwebble isn't sick!
ja: ええと、その、いいお知らせなんですけど、イシズマイは病気じゃないですよ!

key: Um... It would be best for Dwebble if it was with an active Trainer...
en: Um... It would be best for Dwebble if it was with an active Trainer...
ja: あの……イシズマイにとっては、活動的なトレーナーと一緒にいるのが一番だと思うんです……

key: TRAINER: I see... If it's what's best for Dwebble, then...
en: TRAINER: I see... If it's what's best for Dwebble, then...
ja: トレーナー: そうですか……イシズマイのためになるなら……

key: Excuse me, would you be willing to look after Dwebble?
en: Excuse me, would you be willing to look after Dwebble?
ja: すみません、イシズマイの面倒を見ていただけませんか?

key: Will you keep Dwebble for me?
en: Will you keep Dwebble for me?
ja: イシズマイを引き取っていただけますか?

key: TRAINER: Thank you. Please take good care of Dwebble for me.
en: TRAINER: Thank you. Please take good care of Dwebble for me.
ja: トレーナー: ありがとうございます。イシズマイをどうぞよろしくお願いします。

key: SHELLY: Would you mind if I kept it? I can keep Dwebble with the other Pokémon in my Gym.
en: SHELLY: Would you mind if I kept it? I can keep Dwebble with the other Pokémon in my Gym.
ja: シェリー: わたしが引き取ってもいいですか? イシズマイを、ジムの他のポケモンたちと一緒にいさせられますし。

key: TRAINER: Of-of course... It would be an honor for Reborn's Bug Gym Leader to adopt my Dwebble...
en: TRAINER: Of-of course... It would be an honor for Reborn's Bug Gym Leader to adopt my Dwebble...
ja: トレーナー: も、もちろんです……リボーンのむしジムリーダーにイシズマイを引き取っていただけるなんて、光栄です……

key: Well, well, Dwebble, looks like you're coming with me.
en: Well, well, Dwebble, looks like you're coming with me.
ja: さてさて、イシズマイ、これからわたしと一緒だね。

key: I hope Kricketot is okay.
en: I hope Kricketot is okay.
ja: コロボーシが元気でいてくれるといいけど。

key: I hope Dwebble is okay.
en: I hope Dwebble is okay.
ja: イシズマイが元気でいてくれるといいけど。

key: Mommy says never to talk to strangers...
en: Mommy says never to talk to strangers...
ja: ママが、知らない人とは話しちゃダメって言うの……

key: I think it's because they smell bad.
en: I think it's because they smell bad.
ja: たぶん、臭いからだと思う。

key: Learning how to trust people in this city again is a challenge.
en: Learning how to trust people in this city again is a challenge.
ja: この街で、もう一度人を信じることを学ぶのは、簡単なことじゃない。

key: But if children can be relied on for anything, it's their undying openness to experiences and people.
en: But if children can be relied on for anything, it's their undying openness to experiences and people.
ja: でも、子供たちに何か頼れることがあるとすれば、それは経験や人に対する尽きない心の開きっぷりだろう。

key: Just stay safe, okay?
en: Just stay safe, okay?
ja: とにかく、安全にね?

key: KRICKETOT: Krrrk...
en: KRICKETOT: Krrrk...
ja: コロボーシ: コロ……

key: DWEBBLE: Krrrk...
en: DWEBBLE: Krrrk...
ja: イシズマイ: イシ……

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: Tch, this sucks.
en: Tch, this sucks.
ja: チッ、最悪だ。

key: All of the old crew broke apart when our hideout was renovated.
en: All of the old crew broke apart when our hideout was renovated.
ja: アジトが改装されて、昔の仲間たちはバラバラになっちまった。

key: Now I got nowhere to do and nothin' to go.
en: Now I got nowhere to do and nothin' to go.
ja: 今じゃ、やることも行く場所も何もねえ。

key: Hey, if you think I'm gonna do community service just cuz I'm bored--
en: Hey, if you think I'm gonna do community service just cuz I'm bored--
ja: おい、暇だからってボランティアでもすると思ったら――

key: ...Eh, why not.
en: ...Eh, why not.
ja: ……ま、いいか。

key: I go down to Coral and see what there is to do.
en: I go down to Coral and see what there is to do.
ja: コーラルに行って、何かやることがないか見てくるか。

key: Mommy, I can go play with those people again tomorrow, right?
en: Mommy, I can go play with those people again tomorrow, right?
ja: ママ、明日もあの人たちと遊びに行っていいよね?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
